Surge Damping Timing Curve (AT/CVT Gear 1)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1).
Details: When used: AT/CVT only (FFF88ADA bit 7 clear; it is always set on this manual coding), gear FFF88FCE = 1 (0x0DBB20, read: the AT/CVT curve branch, mirrored by the MT branch that reads Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1); the MT coding flag s4 picks the MT curve). Full-scale timing correction (degrees, negative = retard) by the largest throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE since the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 set (0x0DBB20 holds the maximum in FFF8B0F0 and resets it to 0 while the trigger is clear, read), before the phase, coolant, mode and cal factors (read). Surge damping term FFF8A758 (0x0DBB20, called from the 10 ms module 0x0DE0E0; stack args verified with callers.py: s0 = gear FFF88FCE, s4 = MT coding FFF88ADA bit 7, s8 = FFF8B0EE, s12 = rpm FFF8CE9C, s16 = FFF88C64 bit 5, s20 = combustion mode FFF8A85C, read): A758 = Curve(FFF8B0EE) x PhaseFactor(FFF8A75E) x CoolantFactor FFF8A75C x ModeFactor(A85C) x cal factor (MT coding: cal 0x306E5 = 254, or cal 0x306E7 = 128 once FFF88C64 bit 5 has been clear for cal 0x306E8 = 150 passes) / 255^4, in 0.5-degree units, capped at +63.5 degrees, and 0 when the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 is clear or when the current swing count has lasted longer than its time cal 0x306EA..0x306FA (100/20/100/10/100/5/100/100/100 passes of 10 ms for counts 0..8) (read). A758 is added to the final timing sum in 0x0D9E40 (read), so negative values retard. Trigger (read): 0x0DC1E8 counts passes while FFF8A7A1 bit 3 is set, the throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE >= cal 0x3084E (131 = 0.4 % per 20 ms, MT; hysteresis 0x3084C) and FFF8B112 (0x0E0D14 of FFF88A3A) <= cal 0x30842; 0x0E1350 sets FFF8A7A1 bit 2 when that count exceeds a per-gear, per-rpm-band threshold (cals 0x30F62..0x30FAC); it is dropped after cal 0x30850 (90) active passes. FFF8A75E counts rpm swings (0x0DC324, see p17p_surge_phase). FFF88FCE is the gear: on the MT coding 0x08254C copies FFF8A8B6, which 0x11422C derives from the ratio gear FFF8A623 (read). Reading: a timing intervention after a throttle step that retards while rpm swings up and releases while it swings down, i.e. driveline surge (shuffle) damping. Confidence: read.

Alternate minimum rpm in the next gear up, by pedal and gear, for an upshift to be advised by the gear advice function.
Details: When used: instead of 05D5D0 when FFF8A8C3 = 2. Gear advice module 0x116A0C. With the bit set it takes the current power (torque x rpm / 9549.3), the engine speed in the gear below (FFF8B434, gear FFF8A8BA = gear - 1, 0x114360) and in the gear above (FFF8B436, gear FFF8A8BC = gear + 1, 0x1143CC), looks up the consumption map at the three points and advises the gear with the lowest value (FFF85678 / FFF85679, biases cal 0x36E4E/0x36E50 = 3 %). 'Alternate' tables are used when FFF8A8C3 = 2. 0x116A0C (read): FFF85646 = this(pedal FFF88A5E, upper gear FFF8A8BC); the upper gear is advised only if its engine speed FFF8B436 >= FFF85646. Confidence: inferred.
